purpose: The complete, de-duplicated, severity-ranked findings ledger consolidating all 6 independent auditors' work across the 16 lettered trust boundaries (A-P), feeding directly into 31-final-verdict.json's pass-gate checklist.
deduplicationNote: 25-cross-module-failure-propagation.json's Chain 2 finding and 28-static-danger-pattern-audit.json's SP-1 finding are the SAME underlying defect (semantic-coverage/cross-reference-audit.ts's coveringProvision lookup never consulting candidateSourceNodeIds), independently surfaced via two different methodologies (executed end-to-end test vs. static grep). Counted ONCE below as BLOCKER-6.

blockers.title: P1-10 rank-stack fix incomplete: all 7 residual anomalies are MATERIAL_STRUCTURAL_ERROR, not benign
blockers.evidence: CONMED (1) and DSGR (6) residual SECTION_NUMBER_SEQUENCE_ANOMALY findings independently re-inspected against real source text; every one is a genuine in-text citation the plausibility gate's narrower-than-intended regex fails to match, reproducing the original misattachment mechanism (real content truncated from its true section, reattributed to a spurious sibling sharing a real section's label).
blockers.newlyDiscoveredVsResidual: RESIDUAL - directly contradicts the prior phase's own disposition of these same 7 findings as benign.
blockers.blastRadius: CONMED and DSGR packages; any future package whose source text uses citation phrasing not in the gate's fixed phrase list.
blockers.smallestRemediationBoundary: Widen or generalize the plausibility gate's citation-signal detection (e.g. a broader linguistic pattern or a positive top-level-section-signature check) rather than growing an ever-longer phrase list.

blockers.title: P1-11 fix's supersession signal never reaches the discovery pipeline's real terminal output type
blockers.evidence: DeterministicCandidate carries supersessionStatus/supersessionReason; DiscoveredCandidate (the type every real downstream consumer receives) has no such field - runPassDReconciliation never reads or maps it.
blockers.blastRadius: Every consumer of DiscoveredCandidate (context-retrieval, coverage-audit discovery-comparison, semantic-coverage pipeline).
blockers.smallestRemediationBoundary: Add supersessionStatus/supersessionReason to DiscoveredCandidate and map it through runPassDReconciliation.

blockers.title: Prior phase's PROTECTED_BY_INDEPENDENCE_INVARIANT label for coverage-audit/source-inventory.ts does not survive a direct read of the independence-contract test
blockers.evidence: tests/contract-model/coverage-audit-independence.test.ts's actual forbidden-import list, read line-by-line, never mentions amendment/* at all.
blockers.smallestRemediationBoundary: Either wire genuine supersession awareness into this consumer, or draft the ARCHITECTURE_CHANGE_PROPOSAL the prior phase assumed already existed to formally justify leaving it unaware.

blockers.title: semantic-coverage/cross-reference-audit.ts fails open on null operativeState (previously disclosed, re-confirmed, correctly not downgraded)
blockers.evidence: Independently re-confirmed exactly as the prior phase disclosed it.
blockers.newlyDiscoveredVsResidual: RESIDUAL - already disclosed by the prior phase, not silently accepted as fixed.
blockers.smallestRemediationBoundary: Fail closed (reject/flag) rather than silently proceeding when operativeState is null.

blockers.title: 5 of 14 LLM-facing evidence tools in semantic/tools.ts bypass operative-state entirely
blockers.evidence: Direct read of every tool's execute() function; 5 tools never consult access.operativeState, including one whose own description tells the model to trust it for 'actual economics.'
blockers.blastRadius: Any AI-assisted extraction/generalization call that uses one of the 5 affected tools on a document with superseded provisions.
blockers.smallestRemediationBoundary: Route the 5 tools through the same supersession-aware access path as the other 9.

blockers.title: DEFINITION-kind operative-state ambiguity silently fails to reach semantic-coverage, can resolve to a confident-but-wrong FULLY_REPRESENTED_VERIFIED
blockers.trustBoundary: K (semantic compilation safety) and K2/independent verification
blockers.evidence: cross-reference-audit.ts's coveringProvision lookup only matches on currentSourceNodeId or sectionRef, both structurally null for AMBIGUOUS DEFINITION-kind provisions; candidateSourceNodeIds is never consulted. Demonstrated real and reproduced: an independently-confirmed ambiguous definition reaches FULLY_REPRESENTED_VERIFIED, violating Architecture Invariant #13.
blockers.blastRadius: Any document with an ambiguously-resolved DEFINITION-kind amendment target that also has a compiled rule anchored to that term.
blockers.smallestRemediationBoundary: Extend the coveringProvision lookup to also match against candidateSourceNodeIds for AMBIGUOUS provisions.

blockers.title: 95 real, already-compiled ContractRule rows still exhibit the pre-fix source-trace defect (unbackfilled)
blockers.evidence: The stableKey fix itself is independently re-confirmed correct via 8/8 freshly-ingested real FWRG samples. However 95 rows compiled before the fix landed, across two real regression packages in the same shared Postgres instance, still silently carry the pre-fix defect.
blockers.newlyDiscoveredVsResidual: NEWLY_DISCOVERED (the fix's incompleteness across persisted state, not the fix's own logic).
blockers.blastRadius: Any pre-fix-compiled ContractRule row currently in the database.
blockers.smallestRemediationBoundary: A one-time backfill migration recomputing stableKey for the 95 affected rows.

blockers.title: Real production sibling-claim identity collision at the discoveryId/semanticUnitId layer
blockers.evidence: The prior phase's determination that the two NAMED narrower risks are evaluator-only is re-confirmed, but this section's own required independent adversarial construction surfaced a separate, new, directly-confirmed real production collision.
blockers.blastRadius: Any two sibling claims sharing the colliding identity components.
blockers.smallestRemediationBoundary: Strengthen the claimKey/discoveryId derivation to disambiguate the specific colliding case identified in 13-claim-identity-certification.json.

blockers.title: Independent verifier reaches false VERIFIED_NO_MATERIAL_GAP_FOUND on an omitted qualifying condition
blockers.evidence: 6 of 7 independently-constructed fault-injection cases correctly caught; the 7th (omitted qualifying condition) is missed.
blockers.blastRadius: Any compiled rule that omits a real qualifying condition present in the source.
blockers.smallestRemediationBoundary: Extend the verifier's fault-injection coverage to include condition-omission and add a corresponding check.

blockers.title: Safe-failure architecture (and the entire contract-model compiler pipeline) has zero live application callers
blockers.evidence: Direct call-graph trace confirms the live application (app/'s server actions via lib/onboarding/documents.ts -> lib/extraction/**) has zero import relationship, direct or transitive, with lib/contract-model/compiler/** at all. Only scripts and tests exercise it.
blockers.newlyDiscoveredVsResidual: RESIDUAL for the safe-failure-specific half (already disclosed by 3F.1.5.R); NEWLY_DISCOVERED for the wider fact that the entire compiler pipeline is dormant.
blockers.blastRadius: Every real document a customer uploads today - none reach any of the semantic-coverage/safe-failure/verification apparatus certified elsewhere in this phase.
blockers.smallestRemediationBoundary: This is an architecture-level integration decision (wiring an entire dormant pipeline into the live product), not a small local fix - explicitly flagged as requiring its own scoped effort, not a same-phase patch.

blockers.title: Architecture Invariant #35 VIOLATED: DebtEvent.sourceLedgerEntryId is read but never written
blockers.evidence: Grep-confirmed across the entire lib/ and app/ trees: the field is read once (lib/financial-core-db/adapter.ts:194) with a permanent `?? undefined` fallback, never written anywhere.
blockers.blastRadius: Narrow - one specific reconciliation link field, not a systemic truth-log divergence.
blockers.smallestRemediationBoundary: Either populate sourceLedgerEntryId at the point DebtEvent rows are created, or remove the field and the invariant's implicit promise about it.
